findings.text: follow-on: the EDAS group key now prefers data_source_path over name (edas_path = signal.get("data_source_path") or name), which is required by the new test's second signal (name "LFP coil current", path MMSYS/other) but also changes production grouping for LCDB and MBDB signals: their name is "LCDB/<owner>/<source_category>/<dname>" and "MBDB/<owner>/<case>/<source_category>/<dname>" while their data_source_path is "<owner>/..." (imas_codex/discovery/signals/scanners/edas.py:428-432,455-463), so their key moves from edas:LCDB/edas:MBDB to edas:<owner>, the group header becomes "EDAS Category: <owner>" and the category-description lookup keyed on EDAS category codes misses and falls back to the generic line; no test covers LCDB or MBDB, only the EDDB-style MMSYS and PSRC paths.

follow-on: the glossary match is a plain casefolded substring on data_source_path and name, so the term "LKAT" also matches inside "MMSYS/curUFPLKAT" and the UFP signal receives both the UFP and the LKAT entry; the test asserts only that the UFP entry is present, so the over-inclusion (a LKAT meaning attached to a signal the test treats as UFP) is unasserted and would not be caught by a regression.

follow-on: the reviewed manifest leaves baseline_suite and after_suite empty although both arms were run and are complete (baseline.log records revision 1cfe9bb61 and '2 failed'; final-gate.log records revision db49a6fb1 and '5 passed'), so the promotion suite-delta reads null from the field it inspects; the arms are recorded only under test_logs and the added-failure count here derives from those logs.

follow-on: test_facility_glossary_is_declared_and_loaded opens "imas_codex/schemas/facility_config.yaml" by relative path, so it depends on the repository root being the working directory; it passes under the reviewed invocation (pytest run from the worktree root) but would error rather than fail informatively from any other cwd, a fragility the test does not declare.

item_verdicts.diff: Read commit by commit against base 1cfe9bb61090d5ed08bcc40458fd5ea608d28983. 096949d2af8c6896c5ee739de0ac45834d176a47 adds the 122-line test file (both tests fail at base). db49a6fb1391384e42da09fdacf75117346f1438 declares SignalGlossaryEntry and EDASCategoryDescription in imas_codex/schemas/facility_config.yaml, adds category_descriptions to EDASConfig and signal_glossary to FacilityConfig, fills the MMSYS category description and the UFP/LFP/HiTe/LKAT glossary in imas_codex/config/facilities/jt-60sa.yaml, and edits enrich_worker: the EDAS group key prefers data_source_path (parallel.py:3844), the per-category description map is built at parallel.py:4112 and injected as the group header at parallel.py:4174 with the old generic line kept as fallback, and a glossary block appends matching entries to each EDAS signal's prompt lines at parallel.py:4300. bb81e7c68fdecd9c150d52c409f2d32080b49b8d adds the evidence fragment. 202 insertions over five paths; no plan, sprint or index state touched.
item_verdicts.done_when: Section 66 done-when: a test shows an EDAS signal whose path contains a glossary term gets that entry and its category description in its prompt, while a signal without the term gets neither, and the JT-60SA config loads with the entries above. The named test is test_edas_prompt_scopes_category_and_term_context_to_signals: its first signal carries path MMSYS/curUFPLKAT and asserts the MMSYS category description ('coil currents') and the UFP entry in its prompt lines; its second carries name 'LFP coil current' and asserts the LFP entry; its third (PSRC/magFluxLp1) asserts HiTe, FPPCC and 'coil currents' are all absent from its block. I re-ran it at reviewed head bb81e7c68 in a scratch tree extracted from the object store (2 passed, EXIT=0) and re-ran the reviewed run's five-test final set (5 passed, 1 deselected, EXIT=0). test_facility_glossary_is_declared_and_loaded shows the schema declares category_descriptions and signal_glossary and that get_facility('jt-60sa') loads the MMSYS description and all four terms, and that signal_member_patterns.MMSYS is unchanged.
item_verdicts.goal_fidelity: The mechanism is delivered: EDASConfig gains per-category descriptions (jt-60sa.yaml:45), FacilityConfig gains a signal glossary (jt-60sa.yaml:218), the category header is enriched while keeping the generic line as fallback (parallel.py:4174), and the glossary entries whose term appears in a signal's path or name are appended to that signal's prompt only for edas groups (parallel.py:4300). The plan's caution that what separates cur1TFLKAT from cur2TFLKAT be settled from data and not written into the glossary yet is respected.

justifications.durability: Two tests pin the behaviour and the negative control shows the glossary injection is load-bearing: dropping the injection block from the head tree's prompt builder leaves test_edas_prompt_scopes_category_and_term_context_to_signals failing (1 failed, 1 passed, EXIT=1) while the unmutated head passes it. The prompt test drives the real enrich_worker through a mocked claim/LLM loop and asserts both the present and the absent cases, including the fallback branch taken for the PSRC signal that has no category description; not 20 because the term match is an unasserted substring so the UFP signal silently also receives the LKAT entry, LCDB and MBDB grouping is untested, and the schema test is cwd-relative.

EXIT=1', and independently reproduced the declared negative control by removing the glossary injection, which gives '1 failed ... EXIT=1'. The reviewed run's own logs are complete and consistent (baseline 2 failed, head 1 failed, head-fixed 2 passed, final 5 passed); not 20 because the reviewed manifest's baseline_suite and after_suite fields are empty so the promotion suite-delta reads null, and the base arm covers only one test file where the head arm covers two.
justifications.fit: The change extends the existing owner rather than adding a second mechanism: it follows the JET dda_descriptions idiom the plan names by reading config data_systems.edas and facility_config.signal_glossary and formatting the entries as prompt lines, the two new schema classes carry the repo's fc: class_uri and required field conventions, and a label scan over the added lines finds no phase, stage, sprint, ticket or version identifier, no plan filename and no worktree path. Not 20 because the EDAS group key was also repointed at data_source_path (parallel.py:3844), a production behaviour change to LCDB/MBDB grouping that the node's stated goal does not require and no test covers.
justifications.goal_fidelity: The node was dispatched to give EDASConfig per-category descriptions and the facility config a short term glossary, and to inject the glossary entries whose term appears in an EDAS signal's catalogue path or name into that signal's prompt lines, filled for JT-60SA. It delivers both schema declarations and both JT-60SA fills, injects the MMSYS description as the EDAS group header while keeping the generic line for categories with no description, and appends the matching glossary entries to each EDAS signal's own prompt lines; the done-when test and the config-load test pass at head. Not 20 because the same commit repoints the EDAS group key at data_source_path, which redirects the category header and its description lookup for LCDB/MBDB signals away from the EDAS category codes the plan frames the header as naming.
justifications.reuse: The facility glossary and the EDAS category descriptions are new owners added to the config schema and filled in the one JT-60SA facility file, and the injection reuses the existing prompt-building path and the existing per-group header idiom instead of introducing a parallel mechanism; the per-category map is built from the same facility_config the surrounding code reads. Not 20 because the group key was changed to prefer data_source_path rather than reusing the existing name-or-path fallback already computed one line above (name at parallel.py:3838), so the same fallback now exists twice with different precedence.
justifications.scope_discipline: git diff 1cfe9bb61090d5ed08bcc40458fd5ea608d28983 bb81e7c68fdecd9c150d52c409f2d32080b49b8d is exactly five paths, all under the declared write paths; no plan, sprint, index or crew state is modified, no generated model is staged, and the declared figures directory is left unused rather than populated with an unneeded image. Not 20 because the parallel.py change bundles a production grouping-behaviour change (parallel.py:3844) beyond the node's stated change, so the blast radius is wider than the diff description the node declares.
